title: Sample Practice Set
source: Fixture paper used by the test suite and for local development — not a real selection test.

groups.instruction: Choose the one word or phrase which best completes each sentence.

questions.prompt: By the time the bus arrives, we _______ for over an hour.
questions.explanation: "By the time" plus a future event marks an action completed before that point, which is the future perfect.

questions.prompt: She works as _______ engineer at a construction firm downtown.
questions.explanation: "Engineer" begins with a vowel sound, so the indefinite article "an" is required before a singular job title introduced for the first time.

questions.prompt: He _______ this same route to work every day since he bought his motorbike.
questions.explanation: "Since" plus a past starting point needs the present perfect to describe a habit continuing up to now.

groups.instruction: Choose the option closest in meaning, or that best completes the gap.

questions.prompt: The manager gave a [[candid]] account of why the project was delayed.
questions.explanation: "Candid" means frank and truthful. The other options describe length, clarity or preparation rather than honesty.

questions.prompt: Our supplier could not _______ the deadline, so the launch was pushed back a week.
questions.explanation: "Meet a deadline" is the standard collocation for finishing something on time. The other verbs do not pair naturally with "deadline".
